verses.pali: Attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti, sammādiṭṭhiyā ca samanuñño hoti.
verses.english: They themselves have right view. They encourage others to have right view. And they approve of right view.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: Someone with these three qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
